author: financial_diagnosis
scope: Root independently audits the whole project; this peer independently reconstructs the finance/code beyond the author checker, concentrating on complete operating and terminal capital closure, treasury schedules, actual dated loan/cash limits and minimum-equity/payout/delay thresholds.
Read full student/instructor narrative and rubric when available, not just a returned checker status; verify every claimed feasible/rejected policy and benchmark matches exact prompts.

Check conditional scenario prices, asset sale/capital contribution and owner flows, finite loan/revolver extinction and perpetual replacement note counted once, and boundaries where modeled funding is unavailable.
Original bounded teaching case, not a universal production financial model; evaluate guards against its documented domain rather than inventing arbitrary broad requirements.
No source edits, shared files, child agents or publishing; send defects to root/author for repair, record final payload hashes only after author freeze.
Keep exact source and numerical scope honest; no external human certification or visual QA.
handoff: Inputs, analysis and output exist now; author is still writing narrative and ancillary files. Start useful code/ledger review and finish after final handoff.
